items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: You went ahead with Niki... 'Niki’s Song' was her favorite song... I said that was Niki’s favorite song

ctx.x: And we did those charts, plus several others with the Syracuse Symphony, what year though, I can’t remember.
Well it had to be sometime right after that, so it had to be maybe ‘74, was it before Niki? No it had to be ‘72 sometime maybe.
Later, no much later, much later.
